newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower in cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower in cautious trading.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower as investors traded cautiously in view of the implication of major players in a recent share market scam, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 11.02 points or 0.95 percent to 1,140.65 on turnover of 40 million taka. Of 113 traded issues 75 lost and 37 gained, with one unchanged. "The small investors are still watching the situation," said one broker.
The Securities and Exchange Commission has filed cases against 36 brokers and company executives for share price manipulation that triggered wild price fluctuations late last year.
Beximco Pharma fell 3.29 taka to 139.27 and Bata Shoe lost 3.31 to 149.22.
